description: What you keep from a ticket sale after the seller fee: net per ticket and in total, and the profit or loss per ticket and in total when you give your cost. Works without an account. TixSight (tixsight.com) tracks this automatically for a whole ticket inventory.

cost_per_ticket.description: Optional: what you paid per ticket, in US dollars, for the profit or loss.

list_price.description: Listed (sale) price per ticket, in US dollars, before any buyer fee.

seller_fee_percent.description: Seller fee the resale site takes out of your payout, as a percent of the listed price (default 10).

name: net_payout
title: Net payout after fees
